name: Browse the homepage services and navigate to a service page
description: Checks the homepage presents the verified service overview and a service card opens its dedicated route.
expected: The live sports broadcast detail page opens with its own heading, descriptive content, contact CTA and shared navigation.

name: Use responsive mobile navigation
description: Checks navigation remains usable on a narrow mobile viewport.
steps: Open the homepage at mobile width
Open Our Services and choose TV Production
expected: The menu can be opened, service routes are accessible by touch, and the TV Production page is readable without horizontal scrolling.

name: Contact form validates and avoids false delivery claims
description: Verifies the contact form blocks invalid input and explains when no delivery backend is configured.
steps: Submit the form with required fields empty
expected: Browser validation blocks empty fields; after valid input, the page explicitly explains the demo is not connected to a delivery service.

name: Navigate from About Us to all services and back home
description: Checks key internal routes and navigation remain functional across multiple page views.
steps: Open About Us from the navigation
expected: Each route displays the corresponding page title and content, and the Homepage link returns to the home route.

name: Open the dedicated Watch Our Work portfolio
covers: Watch Our Work See More button
description: Verifies the homepage See More button opens a dedicated, responsive portfolio page with project imagery, behind-the-scenes content, video highlights, and a contact link.
steps: Tap See More From Our Work
Scroll through the highlights and videos
expected: The dedicated Watch Our Work page opens, shows the project highlight cards and behind-the-scenes section, both supplied YouTube videos, and a working Let’s Work Together link.
